name: Himenokouji Rinko
source:
"Hehe, does that make you happy?"

Beautiful, intelligent, graceful, charming, sociable, and a little mischievousー

at first glance, she seems flawless, like an ideal partner

But her love runs way too deep, and she often spirals into obsessive behavior.

Even worse, she's completely unaware of how obsessive she can be—

a violent train of love and affection.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3862740/Love_Advisor_Youre_a_mess_and_I_adore_you/]Steam[/url]]
